context: An online retailer needs a controlled returns and refunds workflow covering eligibility, evidence, approvals, exchanges, notifications, auditability, and peak demand.

requirements.text: Customers must be able to submit a return request for a delivered order within 30 days.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how a customer starts a return and the allowed period.

requirements.text: The system must verify that the requester owns the order before accepting a return.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how order ownership is verified.

requirements.text: Personalized and perishable products must be rejected as non-returnable unless they are defective.
Customers should be able to attach photos when reporting a damaged product.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what evidence is needed for damaged goods.

requirements.text: Approved refunds must be sent to the original payment method within five business days.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how and when an approved refund is paid.
requirements.condition: to original payment method within five business days

requirements.text: An exchange request must reserve replacement inventory before the return is confirmed.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how exchanges handle replacement stock.

requirements.text: Refunds above five million VND require supervisor approval.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask about approval limits for high-value refunds.
requirements.condition: when refund exceeds five million VND

requirements.text: Customers should receive notifications whenever the return status changes.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how customers track a return.

requirements.text: Every approval, rejection, and refund action must be recorded in an immutable audit trail.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask about accountability and audit records.
requirements.condition: for every approval rejection and refund

requirements.text: The return service must support at least 100 concurrent submissions during campaign peaks.
